# Little AI

> Little AI is an AI consultancy that works with enterprises and domain experts to integrate AI deeply into vertical industries (accounting, legal, geological hazard assessment, AI infrastructure). Services: consulting, system design, system integration, forward deployed engineering and AI products. Contact: jilong.liao@little-ai.io

## Pages

- [Little AI (English)](https://www.little-ai.io/index.md): Services, approach, selected work, team and FAQ in Markdown
- [Little AI (中文)](https://www.little-ai.io/zh/index.md): 服务、工作方式、案例、团队与常见问题（Markdown）
- [Full content](https://www.little-ai.io/llms-full.txt): Both languages in one file

## Work and code

- [tinker-ai](https://github.com/little-ai-io/tinker-ai): Vertical-domain AI agent that generates geological hazard assessment reports with Word output and CAD drawings
- [geo-hazard-assessment-workbench](https://github.com/little-ai-io/geo-hazard-assessment-workbench): Web app for the report lifecycle, site data, Word and DWG tracking
- [keystone](https://github.com/little-ai-io/keystone): Digital associate for law firms on locally deployed open-source models
- [ansible-playbooks](https://github.com/little-ai-io/ansible-playbooks): Machine provisioning playbooks
- [Engineering blog](https://jilongliao.github.io/): Technical write-ups
